_note: Public model providers the privacy gateway may use, in order. Every request is redacted first. The first entry uses the caller's own key (N.E.K.O's Dahl key). A fallback needs enabled=true, a model, and a key FILE NAME under D:\jarvis-secrets (the key itself never goes in this file). Free tiers change: check the provider's current terms (jarvis/docs/neko/evidence/06-models-hardware-providers.md section 9). Gemini's free tier is excluded for personal data (its terms allow training on it).
